task.description: WF-02 Step 2d: REVIEWER hard gate on REQ-377's implementation, run after SECURITY-REVIEWER PASS. Check idiomatic-vs-crutch, supervision integrity (new Letflow.EventStore.RetirementTaskSupervisor child), process-vs-row consistency (REQ-045 precedent), the requested_by no-FK deviation for idiomatic soundness (not just security), scope creep against the approved design doc, type-safety gaps, and docs/anti-patterns.md.
acceptance_criteria: the retirement screen lets a PLATFORM_ADMIN retire the oldest eligible month and displays the resulting retirement record, matching EO-001's operator-console evidence requirement
the retention summary shows a protected-record count capturable before and after a retirement, matching EO-002's evidence requirement
the screen is reachable only to a PLATFORM_ADMIN-equivalent role from the operator console navigation
web/tests/e2e/pipelines/platform-partition-retention-drop.pipeline.e2e.spec.ts is authored against this real screen and passes

result.summary: Idiomatic vs crutch: PASS -- RetentionOperations is a plain context module, Task.Supervisor.async_nolink/3 + a DB row as source of truth, straight structural copy of MigrationRollout's already-reviewed shape. Supervision integrity: PASS, verified by reading lib/letflow/supervisor/infrastructure.ex directly -- RetirementTaskSupervisor added as child 20 of 21, placed immediately before Obs.Alerts.TaskSupervisor, preserving that supervisor's documented 'last child' invariant; each retirement instance isolated via its own DB row + independent per-schema task. Process-vs-row consistency: PASS, plain async work not a disguised gen_statem, matches REQ-045/MigrationRollout precedent. requested_by no-FK deviation: PASS, idiomatically sound and NOT novel -- found a closer precedent than ELIXIR-DEV cited: priv/repo/migrations/20260918000001_create_platform_help_content.exs already carries a bare :binary_id created_by column with no FK for the same global-table/tenant-scoped-actor-table reason; non-blocking note to cite that precedent explicitly in future instances. Scope creep: none found, every file/endpoint/type matches the design doc 1:1 (router paths, :TenantsManage reuse, response shapes, TS types verbatim, StatusBadge domain additions, nav/router entries). Type-safety: non-blocking note only (status fields are plain :string + validate_inclusion, not Ecto.Enum -- consistent with MigrationRollout's own existing convention, not a new gap). Anti-patterns: none triggered.
